decisions.summary: VirBk/Grok is the working remote. Otto and Virbos are read-only references.
The factory is copied as AGENTS.md plus factory/. SESSION_LOG is not created. BOARD is generated from JSON.
Idle is success until the owner names the product and drops a spec.
Product is dual-runtime: Claude Code or Grok as control plane; DeepSeek or Qwen as writer. Do not remap the control-plane session.
Sweep writer is DeepSeek Flash or local Qwen. Keystone writer is DeepSeek V4 Pro or Claude. Reviewer is never weaker than the writer. One correction then split, escalate model on the next envelope.
Cloud path is Grok as control plane plus a writer on a worktree clone. No GitHub Action until the secret exists.
Grok is the parent factory. Children copy the kit and return portable intakes. A child never writes VirBk/Grok. An intake without a check is refused. Size budgets regularize.

The session is a fuse. Git is memory. Split on envelope done, correction cap, spend cap, or a named decay sign. Successor reads AGENTS, BOARD, envelope. Never a transcript or compaction. Fresh same-tier instance after a split. Reviewer is always a fresh session. Never resume a session id from prose.
